Membership

Who can join?

The Union brings together economic actors representing the private sector of Arab countries in the energy and minerals sectors: energy, oil, gas and mining companies, institutions, investors, research centers, universities, experts and specialists.

Why join?

  • Join an Arab cooperation network bringing together governments, institutions and companies in both sectors.
  • Access investment opportunities and strategic partnerships facilitated by the Union.
  • Contribute to shaping common Arab visions and action plans for energy and minerals.
  • Take part in specialized commissions, events, and training and research programmes.
  • Strengthen international presence through a platform representing Arab energy and mining industries.

How to join

To join the Union, please contact the General Secretariat via the Contact page, indicating your organisation's name, field of activity and country. The Union's team will share membership documentation and criteria once officially adopted under the 2026–2030 roadmap.

Note: the membership framework and fees are being finalized by the Union's competent bodies under the adopted roadmap.
